operations.title: The total-energy Cut corner is transverse and unimodular
operations.body: With q_G12=E_T+y12, the coordinate change (E_T,y12)->(E_T,q_G12) has matrix [[1,0],[1,1]] and determinant one. Thus E_T=0 and q_G12=0 form an integral regular pair with no excess Tor or mod-two carrier defect. The orientation identity dE_T wedge dq_G12=dE_T wedge dy12 leaves only the standard Koszul sign on swapped residues. Any activation of the width-two elliptic Z/2 coinvariant must come from the relative Cayley-Menger/Leray chain packet, not base incidence.

operations.title: Total-energy/Cut corner unimodularity checker
operations.body: The checker verifies determinant one, transverse regular sequence, orientation identity, and absence of a mod-two carrier defect.
